column2: Then I will come again when I have a favor to ask of you.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, got it.{wait}{clear}
Just get going already. I'm still sleepy...{wait}{clear}
Goodbye. Let's meet again.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, see ya.{wait}{clear}
Geez... What an elaborate joke...{wait}{clear}
*Yawn*...{wait}{clear}
Huh?{wait}{clear}...Look, let's save the jokes for another time.{wait}{clear}I'm going back to sleep...{wait}{clear}
Wake him again{n}
Try another time
...You don't give up, do you?!{wait}{clear}
Rudiere, I need you to hear me out.{wait}{clear}
...Phew. Fine, say it.{wait}{clear}I'm wide awake now anyway.{wait}{clear}
Whoa, whoa, that's out of nowhere... Are you for real?{wait}{clear}
I know this is a sudden request. But I truly need your help.{wait}{clear}
.....{wait}{clear}All right. I'll help.{wait}{clear}I don't really get it, but it looks like you're asking in earnest, at least.{wait}{clear}
Thank you. I will come again when there is something I must ask of you.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, truly.{wait}{clear}
...Sorry, but could we do this some other time?{wait}{clear}I don't really get any of it. It feels like a dream.{wait}{clear}
...I understand. I will come back another day.{wait}{clear}
...Well, I'll think about it.{wait}{clear}
...Tch, geez. Just let me sleep in peace...{wait}{clear}
Rudiere!{wait}{clear}
Hm? You... You came back, huh?{wait}{clear}
I would like to ask for your help.{wait}{clear}
You look serious.{wait}{clear}Well, all right, I'll help. I don't really get it, but you seem to mean it.{wait}{clear}If there's something I can do, just tell me.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, it's fine. Come by anytime.{wait}{clear}
He should be here... Rudiere... are you there?{wait}{clear}
Rudi...?{wait}{clear}Huh? He's not here... I wonder if he went out somewhere...{wait}{clear}
Rudi...?{wait}{clear}Oh? It seems he isn't here... I wonder if he went out somewhere...{wait}{clear}
With that crooked noble gone, the villagers were very grateful, weren't they?{wait}{clear}
Yeah, but... the royal family let a guy like that run wild out here...{wait}{clear}Which means I... share the blame too.{wait}{clear}
Being thanked for it feels kind of awkward...{wait}{clear}
You did the right thing...{n}
I see...{n}
No, you yourself did the right thing, Rudi. Can't you at least accept that?{wait}{clear}
Well, I guess... Thinking that way does feel better...{wait}{clear}
I see...{wait}{clear}You feel responsible as a member of the royal family, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
Responsible...? It's nothing that grand.{wait}{clear}It's just... I figure if I were in their shoes, I wouldn't stand for it...{wait}{clear}That's all...{wait}{clear}
The Slums
This area hasn't changed...{wait}{clear}
Where are we?{wait}{clear}

It's where the poor gather. People call it the slums.{wait}{clear}This is one of the more prosperous cities in the old Eastern Kingdom, but...{wait}{clear}lots of people from the poor regions around here moved in chasing its wealth, and a place like this was the result.{wait}{clear}...Hm?{wait}{clear}What's that? A child's voice.{wait}{clear}
...That kid must really hate nobles. He didn't even want to talk to me.{wait}{clear}

There are a lot of places like this in the old Eastern Kingdom.{wait}{clear}The west has history and it's prosperous, but here in the east everyone's still poor, and most people are ruled by a handful of nobles.{wait}{clear}Everyone thinks nobles are good for nothing.{wait}{clear}See, my mother came from the east, and when I was really little I lived out here.{wait}{clear}So I hope someday the people here can stop hating nobles and royals.{wait}{clear}
Someday, it will be...{n}
You can do it, Rudi.{n}
I hope that day comes.{wait}{clear}
